name: todo-list-codex
description: Codex plugin for reading and writing the local Todo List app database.

interface.shortDescription: Let Codex read, create, update, and delete local todos.
interface.longDescription: Exposes the Todo List app SQLite database through a local MCP server so Codex can inspect todos, manage tags, create tasks, and update task state without a separate network service.
